requests.name: 1. Start visit (assessor -> assessable field)
requests.testScript:
pw.test("201", () => pw.expect(pw.response.status).toBe(201));
const v = pw.response.body.data.visit; if (v) pw.env.set('visitId', v.id);

requests.name: 2. Push location (assessor live position)
requests.description:
The assessor pushes a live GPS position on an active visit. Only the visit's OWN assessor may push (else 403); the visit must be active (else 400). Range-validated (lat -90..90, lng -180..180). REST mirrors the `visit:location` socket event and also broadcasts to the visit room, so the farmer/admin map updates either way.

### Expected (200)
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Location updated.", "data": { "visit": { "status": "en_route", "last_latitude": 28.65, "last_longitude": 77.15, "last_location_at": "..." } } }
```

requests.name: 3. Mark arrived
requests.description:
The assessor marks arrival (status en_route -> arrived). Assessor-only. Broadcasts `visit:status` to the room.

### Expected (200)
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Marked as arrived.", "data": { "visit": { "status": "arrived", "arrived_at": "..." } } }
```

requests.name: 4. End visit (completed / cancelled)
requests.description:
The assessor ends the visit - `outcome` is `completed` (default) or `cancelled`. Assessor-only; the visit must still be active. After ending, location pushes are rejected (visit no longer active) and location sharing stops.

### Expected (200)
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Visit ended.", "data": { "visit": { "status": "completed", "ended_at": "..." } } }
```

requests.name: My active visit (assessor)
requests.description: The assessor's current active visit, or `{ visit: null }`. Assessor-only. Use on app resume to re-attach to an in-progress visit.

requests.name: My incoming visit (farmer)
requests.description: The visit currently heading to THIS farmer (someone en route/arrived), or `{ visit: null }`. Needs a FARMER token. The farmer then joins the socket room `visit:<id>` to watch the assessor move live.

requests.name: Get one visit (assessor / farmer / admin)
requests.description: One visit by id. Readable only by its assessor, its farmer, or an admin (else 403). Returns the current snapshot including `last_latitude`/`last_longitude` so a late joiner can render the position without replaying the socket stream.

requests.name: All active visits (admin live view)
requests.description:
Every currently-active visit across the platform. ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN only. Powers the admin 'Live visits' page, which then subscribes to each visit's socket room for the live stream.

### Expected (200)
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Active visits fetched.", "data": { "visits": [ { "id": "...", "assessor_name": "...", "farmer_name": "...", "status": "en_route", "last_latitude": 28.65, "last_longitude": 77.15 } ] } }
```
